answer: Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 32% of the attester's bond. Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the onyx registry records each claim and the zenith audit publishes every slash. A farm must hence either lie, which the lotus graph proves on replay, or recruit 132 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. That is 9 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
